indicator_name: Gross inflow of foreign direct investment into Kazakhstan from foreign direct investors, by country
description: Валовой приток прямых иностранных инвестиций в Казахстан от иностранных прямых инвесторов, по странам
unit: million USD, flow over the quarter
methodology: NBK formId=287, one row per investor country (128 in 2005-2026). Items: ISO3 codes (dictionaries/partner_countries.csv; nbk_cube.COUNTRY_ALIASES for the NBK's spellings), INTORG = international organisations, UNALLOCATED = «Not determined by country», TOTAL = all rows. Dated by the quarter covered (the NBK's report_date is the day after it). TOTAL equals FDI_GROSS_INFLOW_BY_INDUSTRY's TOTAL in every quarter.
